mapper.select: SELECT om.MODEL AS model, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP AS customerAdap, vda.BUILD_WEEK AS buildWeek, vda.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, vda.VIN AS vin, vda.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION AS countryOfOperation, variants.FAMILY_ID AS familyId, variants.VARIANT_ID AS variantId FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL vda INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om ON vda.SERIE = om.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = om.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_VARIANTS variants ON vda.SERIE = variants.SERIE AND vda.CHNR = variants.CHNR WHERE vda.SERIE = #{serie} AND vda.CHNR = #{chno}

SELECT SYMBOL AS symbol, FUNCTION_GROUP AS functionGroup, DESCRIPTION AS description, FAMILY_ID AS familyId FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT WHERE FAMILY_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{familyId}, '%') AND VARIANT_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{variantId}, '%') ORDER BY CONCAT(LPAD(FUNCTION_GROUP,4,' '), LPAD(FAMILY_ID,3,'0'))
